notes: Torah #235 has zero cause/effect (eitza/cause) edges in torahData.js. The dataset contains no edges at all for reference=235. The packages file contains 3 packages with 8 nodes total (Package 1: Yom Tov/regel/moed, good; Package 2: laughter/fallen joys, evil; Package 3: idol worship/shame/disgracing festivals, evil), all derived from source text bechina analysis. The Torah's causal structure is: damaging Yom Tov joy -> regel moed (slipping foot) -> falling -> world's laughter (fallen joys) -> shame (because disgracing moadim = idol worship = shame). The inter-package eitza flow would be: Package 1 (damaged) -> Package 2 (fallen joys manifest) -> Package 3 (shame results). Sometimes the fall serves as atonement; sometimes it only serves as a reminder to repent. With zero eitza edges in the dataset, there are no nodes to assign.
